get.description: Retrieves IM message metrics over time by direction, with time-series granularity.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start date for metrics. Required when duration is CUSTOM_IN_DATE or CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS. For CUSTOM_IN_DATE, use dd-mm-yyyy format. For CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS, pass the start time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

schema.description: Start date for metrics. Required when duration is CUSTOM_IN_DATE or CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS. For CUSTOM_IN_DATE, use dd-mm-yyyy format. For CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS, pass the start time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End date for metrics. Required when duration is CUSTOM_IN_DATE or CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS. For CUSTOM_IN_DATE, use dd-mm-yyyy format. For CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS, pass the end time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

schema.description: End date for metrics. Required when duration is CUSTOM_IN_DATE or CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS. For CUSTOM_IN_DATE, use dd-mm-yyyy format. For CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS, pass the end time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Duration to filter the metrics. Possible values: LAST24HOURS, TODAY, YESTERDAY, LAST_7_DAYS, LAST_30_DAYS, THIS_WEEK, LAST_WEEK, THIS_MONTH, LAST_MONTH, CUSTOM_IN_DATE, CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS, LAST_1_HOUR.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Time granularity for trend data. Use HOURLY when the range is within 24 hours, otherwise DAY.

parameters.name: dimension
parameters.description: Metric dimension for message direction counts.

parameters.name: dimensionValue
parameters.description: Direction values to include in the response. This is a list-based parameter; pass one or more comma-separated values. Possible values: TOTAL, INCOMING, OUTGOING.

parameters.name: integrationService
parameters.description: Filter message metrics by integration service. Possible values: TELEGRAM, TWILIO, IM_TALK, LINE, WECHAT, WECOM, WHATSAPP, FACEBOOKMESSENGER, INSTAGRAM.

parameters.name: departmentId
parameters.description: Filter message metrics for channels in the given department.

parameters.name: channelIds
parameters.description: Filter message metrics by channel IDs. Comma-separated list of channel IDs.

get.description: Retrieves IM conversation metrics over time by status or contact type, with time-series granularity.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start date for metrics. Required when duration is CUSTOM_IN_DATE or CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS. For CUSTOM_IN_DATE, use dd-mm-yyyy format. For CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS, pass the start time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

schema.description: Start date for metrics. Required when duration is CUSTOM_IN_DATE or CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS. For CUSTOM_IN_DATE, use dd-mm-yyyy format. For CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS, pass the start time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End date for metrics. Required when duration is CUSTOM_IN_DATE or CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS. For CUSTOM_IN_DATE, use dd-mm-yyyy format. For CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS, pass the end time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

schema.description: End date for metrics. Required when duration is CUSTOM_IN_DATE or CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS. For CUSTOM_IN_DATE, use dd-mm-yyyy format. For CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS, pass the end time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Duration to filter the metrics. Possible values: LAST24HOURS, TODAY, YESTERDAY, LAST_7_DAYS, LAST_30_DAYS, THIS_WEEK, LAST_WEEK, THIS_MONTH, LAST_MONTH, CUSTOM_IN_DATE, CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS, LAST_1_HOUR.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Time granularity for trend data. Use HOURLY when the range is within 24 hours, otherwise DAY.

parameters.name: dimension
parameters.description: Metric dimension for conversation counts. Use STATUS for TOTAL, ATTENDED, or UNASSIGNED counts, or CONTACT_TYPE for NEW or EXISTING contacts.

parameters.name: dimensionValue
parameters.description: Dimension values to include in the response. This is a list-based parameter; pass one or more comma-separated values. When dimension is STATUS, possible values: TOTAL, ATTENDED, UNASSIGNED. When dimension is CONTACT_TYPE, possible values: NEW, EXISTING.

parameters.name: basedOn
parameters.description: Criteria used to apply the time range. CONTACT_LASTACTIVE uses contact last active time. AGENT_LASTACTIVE uses agent last active time.

parameters.name: integrationService
parameters.description: Filter conversation metrics by integration service. Possible values: TELEGRAM, TWILIO, IM_TALK, LINE, WECHAT, WECOM, WHATSAPP, FACEBOOKMESSENGER, INSTAGRAM.

parameters.name: departmentId
parameters.description: Filter conversation metrics for channels in the given department.

parameters.name: channelIds
parameters.description: Filter conversation metrics by channel IDs. Comma-separated list of channel IDs.

parameters.name: agentIds
parameters.description: Filter conversation metrics by agent IDs. Comma-separated list of agent IDs.
